column2: $$お師匠様$$, really...
You're safe!!
Oh! I must record this joyful event in my $$日記$$!
Stop calling me $$お師匠様$$!
I am now...
no more than a $$邪教徒$$ who believes in the $$邪神$$'s descent!
If you say so... Could it be?!
Have you finally found a way to unseal the $$大邪神$$ armor?!
Hey, old man, what have you been going on about...
this armor business?
According to traditions among us black $$羽$$,
in the distant age of myth, this entire $$世界$$ was ruled by one who believed in $$愛$$, hypocrisy, and $$自由$$—
$$大悪神・ゴッド$$.
But then one day,
our $$救世主$$, the great $$大天使$$ Lord $$メフィスト$$...
began a holy war under the banner of $$父なる大神サタン$$,
and is said to have waged a long 666-day war against the white demons...!
The so-called War of the Gods—the $$創世記戦争$$, right.
And those white demons, who were defeated in that war...
died, leaving behind ruined armor...
But the power of the white demons, who ought to be dead, remained in the armor...
and is said to keep granting tremendous power to whoever possesses it...
So that's the true nature of the $$悪魔の鎧$$ of the $$邪道騎士$$ I've heard about...
Hey, hey, $$おにいちゃん$$!
($$プリカ$$ doesn't really get it...)
